name: CB S205FR renderer API test
description: 1.20.1-era client mod: once the client has started, loads the Fabric renderer API's BlendMode, finds a translucent material through RendererAccess / MaterialFinder, and asks for RenderType.translucent(); one CB-S205FR PASS/FAIL line per call, then the tally CB-S205FR n/n; and a RenderType.create(name, format, mode, bufferSize, state) of its own whose state leaves the output target at its default (no TRANSLUCENT_TARGET), so the climbed create path and its buffer size run on their own
